projects.full_details: Designed and implemented an enterprise Star Schema relational model for multi-channel fulfillment operations. Engineered automated ETL pipelines in Python to cleanse raw logistics records, created normalized dimensions and fact tables in MySQL, and built interactive Power BI executive dashboards. Developed sophisticated DAX formulas to dynamically calculate On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery compliance, warehouse inventory holding expenditure, and back-order alerts.
key_outcomes: Streamlined reporting latency from 3 days to real-time auto-refresh
Identified $45K+ in annualized holding cost inefficiencies
Unified 15,000+ disparate records across regional warehouse hubs
projects.summary: "Architected a Star Schema database modeling 15,000+ fulfillment records and 12,480 weekly inventory snapshots across 4 regional centers to track stockout risks and capacity utilization in Power BI."
projects.technical: "Formulated CTE-driven SQL queries for supplier SLA compliance and engineered dynamic DAX measures calculating OTIF fulfillment rates, vendor delivery variances, and holding costs across 60 SKUs."
projects.title: Supply Chain Intelligence

projects.full_details: Engineered an end-to-end clinic scheduling portal with role-based access for doctors and patients. Architected a robust MySQL relational schema with transactional concurrency checks to eliminate double bookings. Implemented dynamic asynchronous filtering by department and availability slots, and ensured secure session management.
key_outcomes: Zero double-booking conflicts via ACID-compliant database transactions
Reduced average appointment booking duration to under 45 seconds
Clean responsive UI with instant doctor availability lookup
projects.summary: "Engineered a responsive web-based medical appointment scheduling platform streamlining doctor search, available slot discovery, and patient bookings."
projects.technical: "Structured secure SQL relational database operations for patient health records and built dynamic client-side dropdown filters with responsive UI layouts."
projects.title: Schedulix – Medical

Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA), normalized feature distributions, and trained a high-performing classification model. Integrated the trained model into a web interface with immediate feedback visualizers.
key_outcomes: Attained 94.2% validation accuracy across multiple fitness classification tiers
Interactive parameter sensitivity controls for patient habit coaching
Lightweight inference engine capable of running in 45 milliseconds
projects.summary: "Developed an end-to-end web application that evaluates user lifestyle habits, BMI, and physical activity to predict fitness levels using Machine Learning."
projects.technical: "Engineered predictive ML feature pipelines processing biometric inputs connected to a MySQL backend and interactive frontend for real-time inference generation."
projects.title: Fitness ML Predictor
